name: velocut
description: AI-native, local-first video editor by Ribbi — runs entirely in the browser. Rust/WASM engine, WebGPU compositing, WebCodecs export; humans and LLM agents edit through the same JSON command protocol.

name: WebCut
description: 🎬 基于 web 端的音视频编辑器。(A web-based audio and video editor.)

name: wasplay
description: Browser-based video editor built on Rust/WebAssembly — no server-side transcoding, no uploads. Import, arrange, cut, and analyze media entirely client-side.

name: ReactFlow-Pipeline-Editor
description: A lightweight node-based workflow canvas for building and validating connected pipelines with dynamic inputs and graph analysis.

name: Product-Flow-Editor
description: A React-based web app that fetches products from an API and lets users visually map them as draggable, connectable nodes on a canvas. Features include adding product nodes, connecting them with arrows, creating and editing empty nodes, and deleting selected nodes — all with a clean and intuitive UI using React Flow.

name: reactflow-nodes-pipeline
description: A node-based visual pipeline editor — drag nodes onto a canvas, wire them together, and submit the graph for validation. React + React Flow on the front, FastAPI on the back.
